description: WP-11 Phase C5b (declared before any run): trim_bump_rho10 (same remove_protrusions thresholds) with the path_v3 controller profile, then clear the cut chip off the bar top: a cut-disabled near-horizontal blade sweep (rho = 10 deg, edge 2 mm above the base top) planned from the scene config only, from 10 mm behind the dome footprint to 5 mm past the bar end along +x. The chip (selector: particles initially in the dome region above the cut) must move >= 25 mm along +x during the sweep, every other piece >= 0.5% of the mass <= 2 mm, no label change while disarmed. REORIENT/PRE_CUT/WITHDRAW/sweep step limits 1 mm and 1 deg per 20 ms step (the C5 live options), SKIM 25 mm/s.

steps.description: trim_bump_rho10 thresholds: >= 90% of the dome's above-plane mass detached, substrate keeps >= 99% of the below-plane mass, <= 1% below-plane mass detached
Push the cut chip (particles initially in the dome region, 0.3 mm above the cut plane and up) >= 25 mm along +x with cutting disabled
